note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Fogging and ozone in occupied spaces are refused without verification and permissions.
Safety information, label permissions, ventilation and exclusion are the checks. Colour and reputation are not exposure controls.

practicalCriteria: The learner treats each chemical or air-treatment proposal as a separate exposure decision.
The learner refuses unverified treatments in occupied spaces.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: Residents or workers are in an occupied space during a proposed treatment.
Safety data or label permission is missing.
